meta.title: FAT Scheduling & Checklist: refused for a user without the Quality Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Quality Manager role and attempt to schedule a Factory Acceptance Test with a defined checklist, observing refusal or absence.
Repeat the FAT scheduling and checklist action as a Quality Manager and compare availability.
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan and record any deliberate RBAC configuration granting access to other roles.
